title: RankCast: Phase-Aware Rank Balancing in MoE Serving
abstract: arXiv:2611.33542v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern large language model (LLM) inference increasingly adopts disaggregated architectures that separate Prefill (P) and Decode (D) phases. Meanwhile, Expert Parallelism (EP) has been widely adopted in large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model serving. However, load imbalance still slows down MoE inference because each layer must wait for the busiest EP rank. The main source of latency differs between prefill and decode. Prefill is compute-bound, and its MoE layers' latency is determined by the maximum token count of the busiest rank. At the same time, under moderate batch sizes, Decode is memory-bound, so the latency is dominated by the maximum active-expert count across ranks. To solve both problems under a unified framework, we present RankCast, a system that reduces rank-level maximum token counts during prefill and active-expert counts during decode. translated_title: RankCast：面向MoE服务的阶段感知秩均衡系统
translated_abstract: 现代大语言模型（LLM）推理日益采用将预填充（Prefill）和解码（Decode）阶段分离的解耦架构。与此同时，专家并行（EP）已被广泛应用于大规模混合专家模型的服务中。然而，负载不均衡仍然会拖慢MoE推理，因为每一层都必须等待最繁忙的EP秩。预填充与解码阶段延迟的主要来源并不相同：预填充是计算受限的，其MoE层的延迟由最繁忙秩的最大token数量决定；而在中等批大小下，解码是内存受限的，其延迟由各秩间最大激活专家数量主导。为了在统一框架下解决这两个问题，我们提出了RankCast，一个在预填充阶段降低秩级最大token数量、在解码阶段降低激活专家数量的系统。对于每个token，RankCast保留预测出的Top-p专家，并选择剩余的……
tldr: RankCast是一个面向MoE推理服务的阶段感知负载均衡系统，针对预填充阶段计算受限（由秩间最大token数决定延迟）与解码阶段内存受限（由秩间最大激活专家数决定延迟）的不同瓶颈，在统一框架下通过为每个token保留Top-p专家并智能分配，降低了EP秩间的负载不均衡，从而减少推理延迟。
en_tdlr: RankCast is a phase-aware load balancing system for MoE serving that, under a unified framework, reduces rank-level maximum token counts during compute-bound prefill and maximum active-expert counts during memory-bound decode, thereby mitigating EP rank imbalance and lowering inference latency.
